title: The Dark Knight — The Interrogation Room
subtitle: Nolan IMAX 70mm & 35mm Prestige Parody · MCU Major Crimes Unit

cinematography_bible.cameras_and_lenses: IMAX MSM 9802 (15-perf 65mm) & Panavision Millennium XL2 with Panavision Primo / C-Series Primes (28mm, 35mm, 50mm, 75mm)
cinematography_bible.lighting_arc: Act 1 opens in murky slate-blue underlit gloom with 4300K green-cyan ceiling fluorescents; snaps violently on shot DK_05 into blistering unfiltered overhead cool-white/sodium-vapor interrogation glare bouncing off pitted concrete cinderblocks and brushed steel.
cinematography_bible.color_grade: Wally Pfister photochemical steel-cyan shadows, bruised obsidian blacks, stark clinical skin highlights, zero warm fill.
cinematography_bible.score_and_sound: Hans Zimmer & James Newton Howard rising one-note razor-string Shepard tone, fluorescent ballast buzz, heavy steel door latches, CCTV static, and subtle low-end gastrointestinal rumble.

cast.name: Damon
cast.wardrobe: Matte-black tactical Batsuit cowl & kevlar plates over damp tri-singlet, dark-teal Wayfarer lenses under cowl, Freestyle Libre CGM sensor visible under gauntlet cuff

cast.name: The Joker
cast.wardrobe: Purple tailored coat draped over chair, dusty green waistcoat, smeared greasepaint scars, purple gloves

cast.name: Gigi
cast.role: Commissioner Gordon (67yo Boonton kindergarten authority, anti-Elon)
cast.wardrobe: Dark trench over GCPD Commissioner jacket, coastal-teal scarf, laminated Boonton behavior clip-chart & wooden pointer

cast.name: Deron
cast.role: MCU Liaison Detective (nonstop Asian food / Clippers / BLACKPINK)
cast.wardrobe: Woven bamboo conical rice paddy hat & ornate red dragon Chinese silk robe draped over GCPD badge & bulletproof vest

cast.name: Hooman
cast.role: Intercom / CCTV Hijacker (West LA Magic Cone mogul)
cast.wardrobe: Gold Magic Cone blazer over open-collar white dress shirt (on wall CRT monitor only)

shots.camera_lens_lighting: 35mm Panavision Primo 35mm lens, slow push inside dark MCU observation room behind two-way mirror; cool cyan-slate reflection on glass, dim practical desk glow.
shots.speaker: Gigi
shots.exact_dialogue: One, two, three, eyes on me. Inside voices behind the glass, Deron. Criss-cross your tactical vest.
shots.tts_text: [harsh, clipped Boonton kindergarten teacher authority, hushed snap] One, two, three, eyes on me. Inside voices behind the glass, Deron. Criss-cross your tactical vest.
shots.tts_direction: Harsh Boonton kindergarten-teacher authority, hushed observation-room snap
shots.visual_action: Gigi taps a laminated red/green behavior clip-chart against the two-way glass while Deron eats takeout beside her in a conical bamboo hat and red dragon robe; beyond the glass, Damon looms in the dark Batsuit over a seated Joker.
shots.sfx_music_cue: Low 60Hz fluorescent transformer hum; distant precinct radio squelch; soft Zimmer sub-bass cello drone begins.

shots.camera_lens_lighting: IMAX 65mm 50mm close-up inside dark interrogation room; Joker's face half-carved in sickly overhead green-cyan pools against pitch-black cinderblock.
shots.speaker: The Joker
shots.exact_dialogue: Good evening, Commissioner. You brought the big bat... and a detective wearing a silk bathrobe.
shots.tts_text: [quiet, raspy, lip-smacking menace, dead serious] Good evening, Commissioner. You brought the big bat... and a detective wearing a silk bathrobe.
shots.tts_direction: Dead-serious raspy Heath Ledger cadence, lingering calmly on 'silk bathrobe'
shots.visual_action: The Joker sits slumped forward, eyes flicking from Damon's hunched shadow toward the two-way mirror, tongue flicking at his scarred cheek.
shots.sfx_music_cue: Single high violin harmonic scrape; damp cloth creak of Joker's purple gloves on steel table.

shots.camera_lens_lighting: IMAX 65mm 75mm tight reverse over Joker's shoulder onto Damon; dark teal-black shadows hide cowl sweat until cheek gleams faintly.
shots.speaker: Damon
shots.exact_dialogue: Where is Harvey Dent? Also, hypothetically, where is the nearest unlocked bathroom on this floor?
shots.tts_text: [bone-dry deadpan Batman growl straining tightly over bowel agony] Where is Harvey Dent? Also, hypothetically, where is the nearest unlocked bathroom on this floor?
shots.tts_direction: Bone-dry deadpan Batman growl straining quietly over severe bowel cramps
shots.visual_action: Damon plants armored gauntlets onto the steel table to stay upright, shoulders rigid, silently clenching through a violent gut spasm.
shots.sfx_music_cue: Wet kevlar suit squeak; deep low-end gastrointestinal rumble echoing faintly in the dark concrete room.

shots.camera_lens_lighting: Panavision 50mm tight two-shot profile; shallow depth of field across the pitted metal table under flickering cyan tube.
shots.speaker: The Joker
shots.exact_dialogue: Never start with the head. Wait—are you trembling? Let's put a smile on that colon.
shots.tts_text: [delighted, unhurried, deeply sinister curiosity] Never start with the head. Wait—are you trembling? Let's put a smile on that colon.
shots.tts_direction: Unhurried, sinister curiosity, savoring Damon's agony completely straight
shots.visual_action: The Joker leans smoothly across the table, studying Damon's trembling knuckles and sweat-slick jaw with genuine fascination.
shots.sfx_music_cue: Rising Zimmer razor-string glissando; metallic chair leg scraping slowly on concrete.

shots.camera_lens_lighting: HARD CUT TO FULL FLUORESCENT BLAST: 35mm wide 28mm shot as overhead sodium-vapor and unfiltered white tubes slam on, flooding the concrete room in brutal clinical glare.
shots.speaker: Damon
shots.exact_dialogue: Not trembling. I took two expired Maurten hydrogels before patrol. I've raced Lake Placid on worse.
shots.tts_text: [clipped, flat, defensively deadpan through gritted teeth] Not trembling. I took two expired Maurten hydrogels before patrol. I've raced Lake Placid on worse.
shots.tts_direction: Clipped, defensive Aquabike deadpan through gritted teeth
shots.visual_action: Blinded momentarily by the sudden white glare, Damon grips his stomach over the kevlar bat-symbol, glaring down at Joker with zero loss of composure.
shots.sfx_music_cue: LOUD breaker switch SLAM! Piercing electrical ballast buzz; sharp metallic bang of Damon's gauntlet hitting table.

shots.camera_lens_lighting: Observation room 35mm tight two-shot; harsh white spill from the two-way glass illuminates Deron's conical hat brim and red silk dragon embroidery.
shots.speaker: Deron
shots.exact_dialogue: Aiya, Damon! Why you no drink hot water lah? Inside look worse than San Gabriel dim sum rush!
shots.tts_text: Aiya, Damon! Why you no drink hot water lah? Inside look worse than San Gabriel dim sum rush!
shots.tts_direction: Thick Cantonese-English, bright urgent scolding (plain ElevenLabs v2, no FX)
shots.visual_action: Deron taps the glass anxiously with bamboo chopsticks holding a steamed siu mai while peering into the bright interrogation room.
shots.sfx_music_cue: Dull hollow chopstick tap against thick mirrored glass; takeout styrofoam squeak.

shots.camera_lens_lighting: 35mm close-up on Gigi in dark observation slate-blue spill; hard top rim-light catches her furious expression.
shots.speaker: Gigi
shots.exact_dialogue: No dim sum in observation, Deron! Your behavior clip goes straight to red if you touch that glass.
shots.tts_text: [snapping, strict Boonton kindergarten teacher command] No dim sum in observation, Deron! Your behavior clip goes straight to red if you touch that glass.
shots.tts_direction: Snapping strict Boonton kindergarten command
shots.visual_action: Gigi confiscates Deron's chopsticks with one brisk swipe like contraband safety scissors and clips a wooden clothespin onto the red zone of her chart.
shots.sfx_music_cue: Sharp plastic clip SNAP; muted commotion on precinct hallway radio.

shots.camera_lens_lighting: IMAX 65mm 50mm circling slowly behind The Joker in stark white overhead interrogation light; crisp metallic bokeh on cinderblock paint.
shots.speaker: The Joker
shots.exact_dialogue: See, madness is like gravity. All it takes is one bad burrito... and a little push.
shots.tts_text: [quiet, theatrical nihilism, slight amused chuckle] See, madness is like gravity. All it takes is one bad burrito... and a little push.
shots.tts_direction: Quiet theatrical nihilism, deadpan earnestness
shots.visual_action: The Joker rests his chin on steepled purple-gloved fingers, tilting his head calmly as Damon breathes slowly through his nose.
shots.sfx_music_cue: Shepard-tone string tension ticks upward steadily; distant police siren wail outside Gotham MCU.

shots.camera_lens_lighting: Handheld 35mm 40mm tight shoulder-height smash-angle as Damon braces over the steel table under blistering top light.
shots.speaker: Damon
shots.exact_dialogue: Word. Keep talking while I hold a Zone-five core brace. You think you scare me, clown?
shots.tts_text: [deadpan, strained, steady courtroom-lawyer cadence] Word. Keep talking while I hold a Zone-five core brace. You think you scare me, clown?
shots.tts_direction: Deadpan NJ lawyer cadence, braced core tension
shots.visual_action: Damon slams Joker's forehead gently onto the metal tabletop, then freezes stiff as a deep rumble shakes his own utility belt.
shots.sfx_music_cue: Hollow steel table THUD; low ominous belly gurgle amplified inside the concrete box.

shots.camera_lens_lighting: Wide 28mm interrogation room shot toward heavy steel entry door; clinical fluorescent light hits Deron's vibrant crimson dragon robe and straw conical hat.
shots.speaker: Deron
shots.exact_dialogue: Wah, Joker! You look hungry lah! Eat my Monterey Park siu mai and Po Chai Pill, good or not?
shots.tts_text: Wah, Joker! You look hungry lah! Eat my Monterey Park siu mai and Po Chai Pill, good or not?
shots.tts_direction: Thick Cantonese-English, cheerful know-it-all enthusiasm (plain ElevenLabs v2)
shots.visual_action: Deron kicks open the heavy steel door holding a crinkly 99 Ranch bag, an iced brown sugar boba cup, and tiny yellow-boxed Po Chai Pills, offering them straight to Joker.
shots.sfx_music_cue: Heavy steel door latch CLANK; boba straw rattling against plastic lid; music cuts abruptly on confusion.

shots.camera_lens_lighting: IMAX 65mm 75mm dead-on close-up of The Joker staring up from the steel table in sterile top light.
shots.speaker: The Joker
shots.exact_dialogue: And who are you supposed to be? Do I look like a guy who ordered room service?
shots.tts_text: [slow, genuinely bewildered, menacing deadpan] And who are you supposed to be? Do I look like a guy who ordered room service?
shots.tts_direction: Slow, genuinely bewildered menacing deadpan
shots.visual_action: The Joker blinks slowly beneath smudged black eye paint, staring straight up at Deron's conical bamboo hat brim.
shots.sfx_music_cue: Awkward fluorescent room buzz; soft ice clink as Deron shakes his boba.

shots.camera_lens_lighting: 35mm low-angle medium shot of Deron leaning against the stark white cinderblocks, looking down like a basketball analyst.
shots.speaker: Deron
shots.exact_dialogue: You got zero ring, like Clippers in May lah! Even BLACKPINK concert got better security than Gotham!
shots.tts_text: You got zero ring, like Clippers in May lah! Even BLACKPINK concert got better security than Gotham!
shots.tts_direction: Thick Cantonese-English, rapid-fire confident lecturing (plain ElevenLabs v2)
shots.visual_action: Deron points sternly at Joker with a small vial of herbal stomach pills, adjusting his red silk dragon sleeve over his GCPD badge.
shots.sfx_music_cue: Crisp silk robe rustle; faint low cello drone creeps back in.

shots.camera_lens_lighting: 35mm Dutch tilt up toward the corner-mounted CRT CCTV monitor and steel intercom speaker; sickly green scanlines clash with white room glare.
shots.speaker: Hooman
shots.exact_dialogue: Chee-chee-chettore! Damon, baba, you have diarrhea in Batsuit, dood? Why you no wear Magic Cone, huuuuh?
shots.tts_text: Chee-chee-chettore! Damon, baba, you have diarrhea in Batsuit, dood? Why you no wear Magic Cone, huuuuh?
shots.tts_direction: Broken Persian-English, booming car-commercial charm with long rising 'huuuuh?' tail (plain v2)
shots.visual_action: The precinct monitor glitches violently; Hooman's face fills the grainy 4:3 screen in his gold Magic Cone blazer, grinning warmly through intercom static.
shots.sfx_music_cue: PIERCING intercom feedback SCREECH; CRT static pop; cheesy tinny speaker resonance.

shots.camera_lens_lighting: 35mm medium tracking shot as Gigi strides into the interrogation room doorway under blinding ceiling lights, face thunderous.
shots.speaker: Gigi
shots.exact_dialogue: Turn that monitor off right now, Hooman! In Gotham Police we sit down and use flushable wipes!
shots.tts_text: [furious, crisp Boonton principal authority cutting across the room] Turn that monitor off right now, Hooman! In Gotham Police we sit down and use flushable wipes!
shots.tts_direction: Furious, crisp Boonton principal authority cutting straight across the room
shots.visual_action: Gigi points her wooden classroom pointer straight up at the corner CCTV monitor, ignoring Joker completely.
shots.sfx_music_cue: Heavy wooden door thudding against rubber stopper; sharp pointer tap on wall.

shots.camera_lens_lighting: Tight 75mm telephoto crop onto the buzzing CRT monitor glass; Hooman's gold suit glows against scanline phosphor flicker.
shots.speaker: Hooman
shots.exact_dialogue: Joker, dood! Fuck that shit, dood! Fifty-fifty on Magic Cone Personal—even Elon Musk want one, huuuuh?
shots.tts_text: Joker, dood! Fuck that shit, dood! Fifty-fifty on Magic Cone Personal—even Elon Musk want one, huuuuh?
shots.tts_direction: Fast West LA fixer pitch, wounded pride flipping into a deal, long rising 'huuuuh?' (plain v2)
shots.visual_action: On the CCTV screen, Hooman waves a gleaming gilded Magic Cone in one hand and a brochure toward the Joker.
shots.sfx_music_cue: Intercom speaker clipping slightly on 'Fuck that shit'; metallic desk chair creak below.

shots.camera_lens_lighting: IMAX 65mm 35mm whip-zoom onto Gigi as she slams both palms onto the interrogation table, lighting her face in harsh clinical under-bounce.
shots.speaker: Gigi
shots.exact_dialogue: Do NOT say Elon Musk in my precinct! His ugly dumpster truck is on the Boonton thinking mat!
shots.tts_text: [volcanic, shrieking righteous fury, slamming table hard] Do NOT say Elon Musk in my precinct! His ugly dumpster truck is on the Boonton thinking mat!
shots.tts_direction: Volcanic righteous fury on 'Elon Musk', slamming the steel table harder than Batman
shots.visual_action: Gigi leans right over the steel table, rattling Joker's water cup and making even Batman flinch slightly.
shots.sfx_music_cue: THUNDEROUS steel table slam; plastic cup toppling and rolling across metal.

shots.camera_lens_lighting: 35mm close-up on The Joker looking sideways at Gigi, bathed in ruthless overhead white shadows.
shots.speaker: The Joker
shots.exact_dialogue: She's scarier than you. Look at her. That's pure, unmedicated chaos... I kind of respect it.
shots.tts_text: [hushed, genuinely impressed, unnerved whisper toward Batman] She's scarier than you. Look at her. That's pure, unmedicated chaos... I kind of respect it.
shots.tts_direction: Hushed, genuinely impressed whisper toward Batman
shots.visual_action: The Joker leans sideways out of his chair slightly, eyes wide in sincere professional admiration of Gigi's rage.
shots.sfx_music_cue: Zimmer string riser drops dead into eerie quiet fluorescent hum.

shots.camera_lens_lighting: IMAX 65mm 50mm tight push-in on Damon rising slowly above the table; white light reflects off his dark-teal Wayfarer cowl lenses and sweat.
shots.speaker: Damon
shots.exact_dialogue: My glucose is one-ninety and this suit fits like wet neoprene. Open that door. Right now.
shots.tts_text: [icy, strained, deadpan ultimatum, barely holding it together] My glucose is one-ninety and this suit fits like wet neoprene. Open that door. Right now.
shots.tts_direction: Icy strained deadpan ultimatum
shots.visual_action: Damon checks the Freestyle Libre CGM sensor on his tricep under the split kevlar plate, standing stiffly like a speed-walker at T2.
shots.sfx_music_cue: Soft digital CGM phone beep; ominous deep low-frequency gut rumble.

shots.camera_lens_lighting: 35mm Panavision Primo 35mm lens medium shot by the doorway; Deron steps aside bowing smoothly in red silk while gripping his boba cup.
shots.speaker: Deron
shots.exact_dialogue: Aiya, go toilet fast fast lah! After, Din Tai Fung soup dumpling in Alhambra on me!
shots.tts_text: Aiya, go toilet fast fast lah! After, Din Tai Fung soup dumpling in Alhambra on me!
shots.tts_direction: Thick Cantonese-English, cheerful urgent hospitality (plain ElevenLabs v2)
shots.visual_action: Deron swings the heavy steel door wide open, holding his conical bamboo hat steady as Damon stiff-walks briskly past him in full flowing cape.
shots.sfx_music_cue: Heavy steel door swinging wide; rapid squeak of armored Bat-boots down linoleum hallway.

shots.camera_lens_lighting: Wide 28mm IMAX closing frame: Gigi snaps the light switch DOWN, plunging Joker and Deron back into dark cyan shadow as the CCTV monitor flickers out.
shots.speaker: Hooman
shots.exact_dialogue: Wait, Damon, dood! Ten billion dollar Bat-Cone! Tell Darren I got guy in Encino! Fuck that shi—
shots.tts_text: Wait, Damon, dood! Ten billion dollar Bat-Cone! Tell Darren I got guy in Encino! Fuck that shi—
shots.tts_direction: Desperate yelling through static, cut clean mid-word (plain v2)
shots.visual_action: Gigi yanks the monitor power cord out of the wall mid-sentence; the CRT collapses to a bright cyan dot while Joker sits baffled beside Deron slurping boba in the dark.
shots.sfx_music_cue: Breaker switch CLACK; CRT power-down pop; loud slurp of tapioca boba pearls through thick straw; abrupt black-out smash of Zimmer brass.
